record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare SPICY_EXTRACT (catalog passive NONE, maxPP 100, range 2). The strategy is shared; they differ in stars (1 and 2) and stats.
record.summary: Puts the closest allies into RAGE. After the base process (PP spent), the strategy picks board units that are not the caster, are on the caster's team and have hp > 0, sorts them by Euclidean distance to the caster, keeps the first [1, 2, 3, 6] by caster stars (CAPSAKID 1, SCOVILLAIN 2) and calls status.triggerRage on each with the requested duration 2000 ms x (1 + AP/100) x critPower on a cast crit (not rounded). No damage, no heal, no target needed (requiresTarget false). Rage effect for an ally that is not yet enraged: enraged flag set, protect cleared, +80 speed requested through addSpeed (Big Eater Belt makes it +100 by x1.25 round down; a MELMETAL passive unit gets the value x0.5 as attack instead; clamped to the speed cap), remaining sleep and freeze durations halved, rage timer set to the duration; an already enraged ally only has its timer extended if the new duration is longer (no second speed buff). While enraged the unit's attacks and ability damage are doubled, and its heals and shields are halved (shared handlers). At expiry the speed buff is reversed with addSpeed(-80); for a Big Eater Belt holder the own-team negative value is scaled too (-100), so the belt gain and loss match (net 0 unless a clamp interfered).

targeting.who: the nbAllies closest living allies of the caster (excluding the caster) on the board, by Euclidean distance from the caster's cell; ties keep board-array (row-major) order because Array.sort is stable
targeting.note: No range limit: allies anywhere on the board qualify. The caster is never included. With fewer allies than nbAllies, all of them are affected.

geometry.shape: none (selection by nearest distance, not by area)

effects.target: up to nbAllies closest living allies
effects.scaling: requested duration = 2000 x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit flag is true); AP is the caster's at cast time; the crit flag is rolled only with ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false. The ally count is not scaled by AP or crit. The +80 speed is not AP-scaled (addSpeed is called with apBoost 0 and the ally as caster).
effects.resolution: applied: a not-yet-enraged ally gets enraged at once with enrageCooldown = requested duration; an already enraged ally keeps its flag and only gets a longer timer. Speed request +80 passes applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff (x1.25 round down: +100) and applyTwistBandBuff (no effect on a positive value), is redirected to attack x0.5 for MELMETAL, and is clamped to 0..MAX_SPEED, so the applied speed change can be smaller than requested at the cap. Expiry reverses -80 (Big Eater Belt makes it -100 because the caster is the ally itself, same team; Twist Band does not flip it for own-team). The strategy ignores return values.

statusEffects.durationMs: requested 2000 x (1 + AP/100) x critPower on crit (raw 2000)
statusEffects.effect: +80 speed (requested), protect cleared, sleep and freeze remaining halved at trigger; while enraged: damage dealt by the unit doubled (handleDamage), heals received halved, shields received halved
statusEffects.note: The rage timer is enrageCooldown; the separate enrageDelay (35000 ms) is a global enrage-at-time timer that ends the timed expiry: once enrageDelay - dt <= 0 the unit stays enraged and the timed end is skipped.

starBehavior.note: Allies count indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (3) and 4-star (6) entries and the fallback 6 are not reachable by the listed units' bare star counts. The duration does not vary by stars.

record.positionalConditions: None for targeting range; only relative distance from the caster matters (the board position of the caster and allies decides who is closest). The unit does not need an enemy in range to cast (requiresTarget false), though the cast still occurs through the normal attack slot when PP is full.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. A second cast on an already enraged ally only extends the timer if the new duration is longer; the +80 speed is not stacked.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 1 (CAPSAKID) or 2 (SCOVILLAIN) allies; rage duration 2000 ms x (1 + AP/100) x critPower on crit; speed +80 per newly enraged ally. Applied: only living on-board allies other than the caster count (fewer if not enough); a newly enraged ally's speed gain is +80, +100 with Big Eater Belt, half as attack for MELMETAL, and clamped at the speed cap; an already enraged ally gets only a longer timer; sleep/freeze halving affects only the cooldown value present at that moment. At expiry the reversal is -80, or -100 with Big Eater Belt (own-team negative values are scaled; Twist Band does not flip it), so the belt's +100 and -100 cancel; any clamp at the speed cap could break the symmetry (not traced).
